text.title: Go Error Handling Patterns (Wrap, Translate, Sentinel, Log-Once) Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to produce a Go Error Handling Patterns (Wrap, Translate, Sentinel, Log-Once) artefact from typed inputs.

step.name: gather
step.action: Confirm every prerequisite is present and recent. Refuse to proceed if any are missing.
step.output: inputs.json with typed entries for each prerequisite
step.decision-gate: Any prerequisite missing - exit with reason; do not synthesize.

step.name: analyse
step.action: Parse + classify each input against the core rules. Tag known vs unknown values. Compute any derived metric the contract requires.

step.name: draft
step.action: Compose draft decision + rationale referencing at least one input by name. Apply allowed-transformations from 02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: self-check
step.action: Run the self-check checklist from 02-output-contract.xml. Match against forbidden patterns and the failure modes in 03-failure-modes.xml. If any hit, fix and re-check.
step.decision-gate: If any forbidden pattern still matches after one fix attempt - escalate to human.

step.name: emit
step.action: Set artefact_id with prefix `goep-`, version=1.0.0 (or bump if updating an existing record), last_reviewed=today. Validate against templates/go-error-handling-patterns.json. Emit.
step.output: final artefact + status flag for owner review

section.title: Implementation sub-procedure (expands steps 3 and 5 when the artefact ships real code)

step.name: inventory-error-classes
step.input: Domain operations + the errors actually observed.
step.action: List the sentinel needs — not-found, conflict, unauthorised, validation, system, throttle — and map each to an HTTP / gRPC code.

step.name: declare-sentinels
step.action: Create the `internal/apperror` package. Declare `var ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found")` etc. plus helpers like `NewConflict("resource already exists")`.

step.name: wrap-at-boundaries
step.action: At each layer boundary replace `return err` with `return fmt.Errorf("<context>: %w", err)` where context is worth adding; convert internal comparisons to `errors.Is` / `errors.As`.

step.name: translate-at-edge
step.action: Build ONE middleware (HTTP) or interceptor (gRPC) that calls `errors.Is(err, apperror.Err...)` and maps to status. Handlers stop translating.
step.decision-gate: If two translators exist, merge them. Per-handler status mapping is forbidden.

step.name: enforce-with-lint
step.action: Enable errorlint + wrapcheck + errcheck; run in CI. Allowlist only adapter code that legitimately bridges a legacy error model.

list.item: Named owner has acknowledged the artefact
